_doc: Lines for scripts/generate-replay-audio.mjs: the Store Insights session replays voiced on ElevenLabs eleven_v4. `text` is what gets spoken (leading [tags] steer the read and are stripped from the transcript); the transcript in src/components/landing/replaySessions.ts must stay identical to the tag-free text. Agent voices are the Shopify app's preset avatar voices (trujilloai-bizmis-shopify-app/app/data/presetAvatars.ts).

lines.text: [curious] Hi! I'm looking for a birthday gift for my sister.
[warm] [quickly] Lovely! I'll pull a few sure-wins. Cozy or practical? Any preference or budget?
[thoughtful] Could you compare the Candle Set and the Insulated Mug? Small apartment, under €50.
[confident] [quickly] I'd pick the Cozy Candle Set. Space-friendly, clean scents, gift wrap available, and it ships in 2 days.
[excited] Perfect, let's do the Candle Set. Add gift wrap and a note: "Happy Birthday!"
[grateful] Thanks, this was super helpful!
[warm] [upbeat] My pleasure! I'm here anytime. Enjoy the celebration!
[upbeat] Hi! Time for my monthly coffee subscription renewal, and I'm running low!
[warm] [quickly] Jane! Great to see you back. How are those Ethiopian beans working out? Ready for your usual Premium Roast subscription?
[enthusiastic] They're amazing! Yes, definitely the subscription again, but I've been eyeing that French press you mentioned last month.
[warm] [quickly] Perfect! I added the Borosilicate French Press to your favorites. It'll pair beautifully with your Ethiopian beans. Let me bundle everything.
[hopeful] Excellent! Could we also add that insulated travel mug? My morning commute coffee keeps getting cold.
[upbeat] [quickly] Done! Premium Coffee Subscription, French Press, and Copper Travel Mug. Same address on Oak Street?
[grateful] Perfect! You always remember my preferences. Thanks for keeping my coffee ritual going strong!
[warm] [quickly] That's what I'm here for! Your subscription renews today, equipment ships Wednesday. Enjoy your perfect morning brew!
[curious] Hi! Do you ship internationally? I'm in Canada and want to order.
[warm] Absolutely! Let me check our international shipping details for you.
[upbeat] [quickly] Great news! We ship to Canada in 5 to 7 business days. Free shipping over $75, otherwise $12.
[relieved] Perfect! What about customs or duties?
[reassuring] [quickly] All customs forms are handled by us. Duties may apply based on local Canadian rates.
[grateful] Excellent! Thank you for the quick help!
[hopeful] Hi! I want to order candles as a gift to my friend in rural Alaska. Can you ship there?
[helpful] Let me check our shipping coverage for that area right away.
[apologetic] I'm sorry, but we don't currently ship to remote areas in Alaska due to logistics constraints. Only major cities are covered.
[frustrated] Seriously? It's still the US! Isn't there any way to make this work?
[empathetic] I understand your frustration, but our carriers don't service remote Alaskan locations. There's no override option available.
[disappointed] This is so disappointing. I guess I'll have to find another company.
